mcp.catalog.badName.text: Server names may contain letters, numbers, "-" and "_" (max 64 characters). "hive" is reserved.
mcp.catalog.badName.note: An error installing a catalogue server (HI-545) under a name a server can't have.

mcp.catalog.expired.text: That download has expired: choose Install or Update again.
mcp.catalog.expired.note: An error installing or updating a server from an MCP catalogue (HI-545): the download made for it was dropped (too old, or the window closed).

mcp.catalog.folder.text: {name}'s zip doesn't hold a folder named {name}: not installed.
mcp.catalog.folder.note: An error installing a server from an MCP catalogue (HI-545): the zip is not laid out as catalogues require (one top folder named after the server).

mcp.catalog.gone.text: {name} isn't in its catalogue any more: refresh the list.
mcp.catalog.gone.note: An error installing or updating a server from an MCP catalogue (HI-545): the catalogue read last no longer lists it.

mcp.catalog.http.note: An error downloading from an MCP catalogue (HI-545): the server answered with an HTTP error {status} (a number such as 404).

mcp.catalog.mismatch.text: {name}'s download doesn't match its catalogue (its size or checksum differ): not installed.
mcp.catalog.mismatch.note: An error installing a server from an MCP catalogue (HI-545): the zip downloaded is not the one the catalogue describes, so Hive used none of it. {name} is the server.

mcp.catalog.needs.note: An error installing a server from an MCP catalogue (HI-545): a requirement Hive checked is not met. {needs} lists them.

mcp.catalog.notInstalled.text: {name} isn't installed from this catalogue: install it instead.
mcp.catalog.notInstalled.note: An error updating a server from an MCP catalogue (HI-545): no server of the name came from it.

mcp.catalog.redirects.note: An error downloading from an MCP catalogue (HI-545): more than 5 redirects. {url} is the address asked for.

mcp.catalog.scheme.text: {url} leads to an address this source may not use (only https for an https catalogue).
mcp.catalog.scheme.note: An error downloading from an MCP catalogue (HI-545): a redirect led away from https (to http or a file). {url} is where it led.

mcp.catalog.sourceTaken.note: An error adding an MCP catalogue source (HI-545): it is in the list already.

mcp.catalog.sourceUrl.text: A catalogue is an https:// or file:// address of its catalog.json.
mcp.catalog.sourceUrl.note: An error adding an MCP catalogue source (Settings → MCP Catalogues, HI-545): the address is neither.

mcp.catalog.timeout.note: An error downloading from an MCP catalogue (HI-545): no complete answer within the time limit (Settings → Advanced).

mcp.catalog.tooLarge.text: {url} is larger than its catalogue says ({max, number} bytes at most): not used.
mcp.catalog.tooLarge.note: An error downloading from an MCP catalogue (HI-545): the download went past the size its catalogue gives, or the limit. {url} is the address.

mcp.catalog.tooManySources.text: Hive lists at most {max, number} catalogues of your own: remove one first.
mcp.catalog.tooManySources.note: An error adding an MCP catalogue source (Settings → MCP Catalogues, HI-545): the list is full.

mcp.catalog.workspaceGone.text: The workspace closed before {name} was installed: nothing was written.
mcp.catalog.workspaceGone.note: An error installing or updating a server from an MCP catalogue (HI-545): the workspace it was for closed while it downloaded.

mcp.error.cannotClear.text: Couldn't read the settings of {project}, so {name} wasn't changed: it may still be added there. Try again once the project can be read.
mcp.error.cannotClear.note: An error replacing, creating or deleting an MCP server (HI-2059): a project's settings file could not be read, so Hive could not make sure the server is removed there, and changed nothing. {project} is the project's folder name, {name} the server.

mcp.error.invalidName.note: An error: an MCP server name Hive refuses.

mcp.error.noProject.text: {project} is no longer a project in this workspace.
mcp.error.noProject.note: An error adding an MCP server to a project, or removing it (HI-2059): the project was removed or moved meanwhile. {project} is its folder name.

mcp.error.noServerAdd.text: The workspace has no MCP server named {name}.
mcp.error.noServerAdd.note: An error adding a server to a project or the Hive Assistant. {name} is its name.
